malaria.advice: Sleep under treated mosquito nets and visit a health facility if symptoms persist.

hiv_aids.advice: Get tested early and speak to a healthcare professional for guidance and treatment options.

maternal_health.advice: Attend antenatal clinics regularly and seek help immediately for danger signs.

nutrition.advice: Eat a balanced diet including vegetables, fruits, and proteins.

mental_health.advice: Talk to someone you trust and visit a healthcare professional if distress continues.
